title: Employ only accredited teachers
what: Employ a person to teach in a school or early childhood service only if they are a registered teacher, hold an interim certificate, or are covered by the Board's authorisation to employ an unregistered person (s 41).

sources.title: Teacher Registration (Northern Territory) Act 2004 (NT)
sources.quote: An employer commits an offence if the employer employs or continues to employ a person to teach in a school or early childhood service in the Territory and: (a) the person does not meet either of the following criteria: (i) the person is a registered teacher
